_comment: MD-CR v4 (3 Oct 2026): the simplified, game-friendly design. Clock-face lines every 120 or 240 min. Each operator leaves Praha every 2 h and alternates its branches. Lines end at the first station after the border (the user's game ends: Čadca for Žilina/Košice, Chałupki for Warszawa, Zebrzydowice for Kraków, Púchov for Ex2). Each line copies a representative real train each way (rep_out, rep_in). slot_A/slot_B move the representative to the line's slot when the real train runs in the other hours. 'out'/'in' list every real train the line stands for. 'folded' lists real trains that run here although their real end differs.

meta.title: MD-CR · Rychlíky Praha – Brno and Leo Express
meta.intro: Simplified Simutrans design for the ČD rychlíky R9 (via Havlíčkův Brod) and R19 (via Česká Třebová) between Praha and Brno, with the R9 Havlíčkův Brod – Brno branch, plus the Leo Express lines. Real JR2026 times (CIS JŘ, every train Mon–Fri 5–9 Oct 2026). The R lines start and end at the odstavné nádraží at Praha and Brno: at Praha on the real times via Praha-Vršovice, at Brno 15 min from the depot to the hl. n. departure and from the hl. n. arrival to the depot, dwell included.
meta.offsets: Offsets count from 01:00, odd hours first (confirmed 3 Oct 2026): offset = (real time − 60) mod interval. At interval 120, L:08 → 8 and S:08 → 68. At interval 240, offset 0 means 1:00, 5:00, 9:00, 13:00, 17:00 and 21:00, so 8:08 → 188 and 6:08 → 68. The same rule applies at interval 480 (offset 0 = 1:00, 9:00, 17:00).

overview.title: How the Ostrava corridor works at Praha
items: ČD Ex1 leaves Praha hl. n. every 2 h at S:08 and alternates its branches: Čadca (for Žilina) at 8:08, 12:08 and 16:08, Chałupki (for Warszawa) at 6:08, 10:08, 14:08 and 18:08.
ČD Ex2 leaves every 2 h at L:08 for Púchov.
ČD SC Pendolino leaves every 2 h at L:31 for Ostrava hl. n.
RegioJet leaves Praha-Zahradní Město every 2 h at L:21 (Praha hl. n. L:41) and alternates: Čadca (for Košice) at 7:21, 11:21, 15:21 and 19:21, Havířov at 5:21, 9:21, 13:21 and 17:21.

Leo Express leaves Praha hl. n. every 2 h at S:23: Zebrzydowice (for Kraków) at 0:23, 4:23, 8:23, 12:23, 16:23 and 20:23. The slots in between alternate Bohumín (2:23, 10:23, 18:23) and Bratislava (6:23, 14:23, 22:23). It stops at Přerov and not at Česká Třebová.

overview.title: How the Brno corridor works at Praha
items: ČD Ex3 leaves Praha hl. n. every hour at :37 and alternates: Budapest via Bratislava (Kúty) at L:37, Wien (Hohenau) at S:37. Back to Praha every hour at :23.

RegioJet leaves Praha-Zahradní Město every 2 h at S:47 (Praha hl. n. L:01) and alternates: Budapest via Wien (Hohenau) at 0:47, 4:47, 8:47, 12:47, 16:47 and 20:47, Bratislava (Kúty) at 2:47, 6:47, 10:47, 14:47, 18:47 and 22:47.
Leo Express Bratislava runs via Přerov, Otrokovice and Hodonín, not via Brno, in the Leo Express S:23 slots it shares with Bohumín.
South of the border every line runs on 10 min per station: Kúty – Bratislava – Budapest, Hohenau – Wien – Budapest.

overview.title: How the R lines work between Praha and Brno
items: Both R lines start and end at an odstavné nádraží. At Praha the real trains run Praha Jih (depot) – Praha-Vršovice (first and last passenger stop) – Praha hl. n., all on real times. At Brno, where the real trains start and end at Brno hl. n., the depot departure is 15 min before the hl. n. departure and the depot is reached 15 min after the hl. n. arrival (dwell and run together).
R9 (via Kolín, Havlíčkův Brod, Žďár nad Sázavou) leaves Praha hl. n. every 2 h at S:04 and Brno hl. n. at S:13.

Timed R9 stops: Praha-Vršovice and Brno hl. n. (the real termini, both ways), Praha hl. n., Kolín (where R9 leaves the main line), Havlíčkův Brod (the junction and longest stop, 3–4 min), Tišnov (3 min both ways) and, going south, Brno-Královo Pole (the stop before Brno hl. n.). R19: Praha-Vršovice and Brno hl. n. (both ways), Praha hl. n., Svitavy (5–6 min) and, going south, Blansko.

R9 Havlíčkův Brod – Brno fills the hours between them every 4 h: Brno hl. n. L:13, Havlíčkův Brod L:01. So between Havlíčkův Brod and Brno R9 runs every hour in the hours when both lines run, as it does in the real peaks.
R19 (via Kolín, Pardubice, Česká Třebová, Svitavy) leaves Praha hl. n. every 2 h at L:58 and Brno hl. n. at S:56.

On Praha – Kolín the R lines run with Ex1, Ex2, Ex3, SC, RegioJet and Leo Express; on Pardubice – Česká Třebová – Brno R19 runs with Ex3 (Ex3 S:37 and L:37 from Praha), so R19 leaves Praha 21 min after Ex3 Budapest and arrives in Brno 47 min after it in the same hour.

meta.title_all: MD-CR · Praha – Ostrava and Praha – Brno corridors
meta.intro_all: Simplified Simutrans design for the workday long-distance trains via Ostrava (ČD Ex1, SC Pendolino, RegioJet, Leo Express, plus ČD Ex2) and via Brno (ČD Ex3, RegioJet and Leo Express to the south, and the ČD rychlíky R9 and R19 Praha – Brno). Every operator leaves Praha on a 2-hour pattern and alternates its branches. Lines use real JR2026 times (CIS JŘ, every train Mon–Fri 5–9 Oct 2026) up to the first station after the border: Čadca, Chałupki, Zebrzydowice, Púchov, Kúty, Hohenau. To the south the lines run on to the cities, 10 min per station: Kúty – Bratislava – Budapest and Hohenau – Wien – Budapest.
meta.hidden_note: The Ex, SC and RegioJet lines are kept unchanged in the pipeline (assets/v4_lines.json, "hidden") but not shown while the work is on the rychlíky and Leo Express.

lines.trainname: EC Ostravan, ends at Čadca (for Žilina)
lines.folded: IC 546/547 Praha – Návsí (5:18 from Návsí, 18:08 from Praha) are not modelled. The 18:08 slot goes to Ex1 Warszawa.

lines.trainname: EC Silesia / Cracovia, ends at Chałupki (for Warszawa)
lines.folded: EC 115/114 Cracovia (real route via Zebrzydowice to Kraków and Przemyśl) runs in this line's 10:08 slot. In the game Kraków is reached by Leo Express.

lines.trainname: SC Pendolino slot (SC, and the IC/rj trains that use the same slot)
lines.folded: The 2-hourly Pendolino slot Praha L:31 / Ostrava L:07 is not only SC. IC 503/504 (Karlovy Vary – Praha – Ostrava), rj 512/515 (Františkovy Lázně – Praha – Bohumín) and SC 500 (Ostrava – Praha – České Budějovice) stop exactly like the SC (Praha, Pardubice, Olomouc, Ostrava-Svinov, Ostrava hl. n.) and run in its slots, so they are this line in the game. Their part west of Praha belongs to Ex6/Ex7 and comes with the western pass. SC 511/517/510/516 and rj 512/515 really run on to or from Bohumín (6 min beyond Ostrava hl. n.).

lines.trainname: EC Valašský expres, ends at Púchov
lines.folded: EC 221/223 and EC 222/220 really run on to or from Žilina. IC 520/521 Praha – Vsetín are not modelled.
RJ 1011 really leaves at 14:25 and runs in the 15:21 slot. RegioJet's Návsí trains (1015, 1017, 1002, 1006) use the same track as far as Třinec and Návsí, which are stops on this line.
RegioJet's Bohumín (1005, 1019, 1000, 1014), Návsí (1015, 1017, 1002, 1006) and Opava východ (1013, 1004) trains run as Havířov or Košice trains in the game.

lines.trainname: Leo Express, ends at Zebrzydowice (for Kraków)
lines.folded: LE 413/414 really run on to or from Warszawa, LE 411/418 to or from Kraków. Leo Express makes only a technical stop at Zebrzydowice. The arrival of LE 418 at Bohumín (16:44) is estimated from LE 413's running time. User rule: Leo Express turns at Praha hl. n. in 20 min at most. LE 418 is therefore modelled 35 min earlier than real (Zebrzydowice 15:51 instead of 16:26, Praha 20:08 instead of 20:43).

LE 415 really leaves Praha at 17:23 and is modelled in the 18:23 slot. LE 1253/1258 (Prešov) and LE 1255 (Ostrava) run as Bohumín trains in the game. Since the Brno pass (4 Oct 2026) this line runs every 480 min (2:23, 10:23, 18:23) and alternates with Leo Express Bratislava (6:23, 14:23, 22:23), which is the real pattern of these slots. User rule: Leo Express turns at Praha hl. n. in 20 min at most. LE 1254 is therefore modelled 35 min earlier than real (Bohumín 6:29 instead of 7:04, Praha 10:08 instead of 10:43).

lines.trainname: EC/rj to Budapest via Bratislava; real times to Kúty, then 10 min per station
lines.folded: EC 283/282 really end at Nové Zámky. The Praha L:37 slot has no real train at 15:37 but the line runs it anyway. The stop before Brno hl. n. gets a timed entry in each direction (user, 4 Oct 2026); the stay at Brno hl. n. itself is the real one.

lines.trainname: railjet to Wien; real times to Hohenau, then 10 min to Wien
lines.folded: The real railjets run on to Villach, Graz or Linz; in the game they all end at Wien. rj 251/250 (Bad Schandau – Praha – Wien/Villach) use this line's slots south of Praha; their part north of Praha comes with the western/northern pass. The stop before Brno hl. n. gets a timed entry in each direction (user, 4 Oct 2026); the stay at Brno hl. n. itself is the real one.

lines.trainname: RegioJet to Budapest via Wien; real times to Hohenau, then 10 min per station
lines.folded: RJ 1037/1030 really run only to or from Wien; they use this line's slots (it passes Wien). The stop before Brno hl. n. gets a timed entry in each direction (user, 4 Oct 2026); the stay at Brno hl. n. itself is the real one.

lines.trainname: RegioJet to Bratislava; real times to Kúty, then 10 min to Bratislava
lines.folded: RJ 1045/1046 really run on to or from Žilina via Bratislava. RJ 1049/1051 and 1040/1042 (Praha – Brno only) are not modelled. The stop before Brno hl. n. gets a timed entry in each direction (user, 4 Oct 2026); the stay at Brno hl. n. itself is the real one.

lines.trainname: Leo Express to Bratislava via Přerov and Hodonín (not via Brno); real times to Kúty, then 10 min to Bratislava
lines.folded: Real Leo Express to Bratislava: 2 pairs a day (Praha 6:25 and 14:23, back from Břeclav 6:07 and 15:00). The line runs every 480 min in the Praha slots 6:23, 14:23 and 22:23, alternating with Leo Express Bohumín. Because Leo Express turns at Praha in at most 20 min, the return is modelled 3 h 13 min later than LE 1216 (Kúty 17:30 instead of 14:17, Praha 22:08 instead of 18:55).

lines.trainname: Rychlík Praha – Kolín – Havlíčkův Brod – Žďár nad Sázavou – Brno, from and to the odstavné nádraží at both ends
lines.folded: Praha hl. n. S:04 and Brno hl. n. S:13 every 2 h, all day. R 973 (Havlíčkův Brod 6:01 → Brno 7:53) and R 970 (Brno 20:13 → Havlíčkův Brod) run in this line's slots but really start or end at Havlíčkův Brod. In the afternoon peak R 983 and R 987 run a few minutes slower between Přibyslav and Brno (Brno 17:53 instead of :44); the line uses the regular midday times of R 981/982. Both ends run to and from the odstavné nádraží (user, 4 Oct 2026). At Praha the real trains start and end their passenger run at Praha-Vršovice and come from / go to the depot Praha Jih (the game's Praha odstavné nádraží): all Praha times, depot included, are the real ones. At Brno the real trains start and end at Brno hl. n.; the depot departure is 15 min before the hl. n. departure and the depot is reached 15 min after the hl. n. arrival (dwell and run together). The stop before Brno hl. n. is timed going south (Brno-Královo Pole); going north it is the depot.

lines.trainname: Rychlík Havlíčkův Brod – Žďár nad Sázavou – Brno, the R9 trains in the hours between the Praha trains
lines.folded: In reality R9 runs every hour between Havlíčkův Brod and Brno in the peaks: the extra trains are R 971 (Havlíčkův Brod 5:01), R 974 (Brno 17:13 → Havlíčkův Brod) and the Praha extras R 985 (Praha 15:04 → Brno 18:53) and R 978 (Brno 15:13 → Praha). This branch carries them in the hours between the Praha – Brno trains: Brno hl. n. L:13 northwards and Havlíčkův Brod L:01 southwards, every 4 h. R 985 and R 978 become Havlíčkův Brod trains in the game. If you'd rather drop it, the 2 vehicles go. At Brno the line runs to and from the odstavné nádraží like the Praha trains: 15 min from the depot to the hl. n. departure, and 15 min from the hl. n. arrival to the depot.

lines.trainname: Rychlík Praha – Pardubice – Česká Třebová – Svitavy – Brno, from and to the odstavné nádraží at both ends
lines.folded: Praha hl. n. L:58 and Brno hl. n. S:56 every 2 h, all day. R 879 (Praha 20:58), R 874 (Brno 5:00) and R 876 (Brno 3:10) are off the 2-hour pattern; the line's slots cover them. Both ends run to and from the odstavné nádraží (user, 4 Oct 2026). At Praha the real trains start and end their passenger run at Praha-Vršovice and come from / go to the depot Praha Jih (the game's Praha odstavné nádraží): all Praha times, depot included, are the real ones. At Brno the real trains start and end at Brno hl. n.; the depot departure is 15 min before the hl. n. departure and the depot is reached 15 min after the hl. n. arrival (dwell and run together). The stop before Brno hl. n. is timed going south (Blansko); going north it is the depot.

not_modelled: Via Brno, not modelled: Ex4, the Ex3 north through trains, R 861 Česká Třebová – Brno (one train), R8 RegioJet Brno – Bohumín, R11 Brno – Jihlava – České Budějovice, R12 Brno – Šumperk and R13 Brno – Olomouc / Břeclav.
not_modelled_hidden: Night and overnight trains: RegioJet 1020/1021 and 1022/1023, Leo Express 1250/1263 and 410/419.
SC 241/240 Košičan (one pair a day). The western continuations of IC 503/504, rj 512/515 and SC 500 (Praha – Plzeň – Cheb/Karlovy Vary/Františkovy Lázně, Praha – České Budějovice): western pass.
ČD IC trains that start at Bohumín for Poland (IC 212/213/216/217 Kraków, IC 302/303 Poznań, IC 306/307 Wrocław).
IC 546/547 Praha – Návsí, and Ex2 IC 520/521 Praha – Vsetín.
